inspections.label: fidelity_workshop_baseline_v1
inspections.observation: Inspected numbered JPEG once: five pale green filament humanoids in a bounded teal contour-lined chamber, purple rear arch, pink suspended filaments and red/gold leaf-like side forms. No recognizable conveyor, piston, cog or workbench.

inspections.label: fidelity_workshop_baseline_v1_pair
inspections.observation: Inspected numbered JPEG once at the same camera 6.9831 animation seconds later: hand/arm positions and pink head-surround orientations change, red leaf-like forms tilt and surface contours shift. Room layout stays fixed; no manufacturing action or visible object exchange established.

beings / presences.observation: Five distinct filament-bodied presences occupy the chamber. This covers visible beings, not reports of unseen presences or all heterogeneous factory workers.

circuitry / machinery.observation: Neither frame shows recognizable manufacturing equipment, conveyors, pistons, cogs or workstations. Dense contour lines and hovering ornaments do not establish machinery; lateral forms read as red leaves.

room / architecture.observation: Floor, enclosing walls, high patterned ceiling and pointed rear doorway form a clear room. Industrial and market architecture variants remain underrepresented.

geometry / patterns.observation: Close-spaced teal/gold contour patterns fill floor and walls; pink zigzag filaments and patterned bodies add distinct geometric structures.

humanoid / bodies.observation: The five presences have clear heads, torsos, articulated arms and paired legs. Their stylized proportions do not reproduce the boxed-body grid variant.

small / miniature.observation: Workers look squat and the rear figure is small on screen, but perspective explains much of the size difference. No familiar product or workstation convincingly establishes miniature scale.

vast / infinite.observation: The rear wall and doorway visibly bound a modest chamber. No endless conveyor, receding factory grid or gigantic worker establishes the reported vast scale.

communicating / teaching.observation: Outstretched hands and suspended geometric objects suggest engagement. Across the pair there is no clear exchange, demonstrated product or readable teaching; the caption is not visual evidence.

intricate / detailed.observation: Bodies contain fine interwoven strands and dense small ornaments, with closely spaced surface engraving throughout the chamber. This does not establish unlimited detail under zoom.

layered / multidimensional.observation: Foreground workers, middle workers and rear arch produce ordinary depth and overlapping filament layers. Impossible dimensions, folding entity corridors and simultaneous organic machine layers are not convincingly visible.

moving / animated.observation: The paired frames show changes in articulated figures, suspended ornaments, side forms and room patterns; manufacturing motion is still absent.
moving / animated.temporal_observation: At animTime 16.7492 versus 23.7323, with unchanged camera, the outer workers' hands/arms and pink head-surround orientations shift, the red/gold leaf-like forms tilt and the teal/gold surface contours drift. This is visible animation, not evidence of object transfer or machinery.

fractals.observation: Fine branching filaments and repeated contour structures suggest fractal detail, but these views do not clearly show nested self-similar manufacturing or fractal assembly-line forms at multiple scales.

jester / clown form.observation: Pink bobbled head surrounds and squat figures have a playful headdress silhouette. No unmistakable clown face, patterned clown body or multiplying limbs distinguishes the validated clown workers from generic elves.

multicoloured.observation: Teal, green, gold, red and magenta/purple are simultaneously distinct across the chamber, side forms, workers and rear arch. This is one colourful synthesis, not a universal factory palette.

white.observation: Some worker strands are pale, but the setting remains overwhelmingly teal and rainbow-accented. Neither a minimalist white factory nor a white-on-black boxed-body grid is represented.

next_corrections: Replace Workshop-only leaf-like growth props with legible lateral manufacturing stations: toothed gears, reciprocating pistons and moving packages, retaining geometry detail and an open central route.
Establish scale through receding production bays and product-sized workers, without presenting the heterogeneous reports as one universal factory.
Retain an explicit contrasting white/minimalist or white-on-black production variant rather than tinting every machine rainbow.
Re-render and inspect a fresh HIGH temporal pair before changing any adverse baseline grade. Preserve baseline files and history.
